searchText: We could only allow CREATE2 from an EOA. Or we could add a second nonce to every EOA. <vbuterin> eth2 is introducing SSZ hashing already, so in the long run it would not add complexity to just use SSZ hashing.... (re @eth1x_bridge_bot: <Paul D.> Is it OK to have two different ways to merkleize things? One way for static lists like code chunks and maybe transactions and receipts. The other way is for merkleizing "non-linear" things like accounts and storage.)
